# Walkthrough videos

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/capture from scripts/capture/assets.json. Do not edit; run `pnpm capture`. -->

Each video is a real run, recorded with Playwright by `pnpm capture` and cut to H.264 MP4 and WebM. The store flows run on the test site (https://reelforge-dev.buildbase.app: BuildBase development environment in test mode, Stripe test card); emails, passwords and licence keys are masked in every frame. Select a poster to play the MP4.

## Claim a free Personal licence

[![Claim a free Personal licence: poster](https://storage.googleapis.com/buildbase/orgs/6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8-fsyqdskf/assets/file-1795338795044-946558329.webp)](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/personal-claim.22165316.mp4)

[MP4](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/personal-claim.22165316.mp4) (1.2 MB) · [WebM](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/personal-claim.22165316.webm) (1.7 MB) · 1280×720 · 106 s · recorded 2026-11-22

**What it proves:** A visitor can sign up and claim the free Personal licence with no payment page, and the key shows on the order page and in Dashboard > Licences.

1. Open the pricing page as a visitor: Personal is free, Commercial is a one-time licence
2. Choose "Get it free" on the Personal card
3. Signed out, so the button opens the hosted BuildBase sign-in page
4. Create a fresh test account (a +test address on the development environment)
5. Enter the verification code (test mode always accepts 424242)
6. Dismiss the optional prompt (passkey or two-factor offer)
7. Dismiss the optional prompt (passkey or two-factor offer)
8. Back on the store, signed in
9. Choose "Get it free" again: the claim needs no payment page
10. The order page shows the Personal licence key (masked here) with the noncommercial reminder
11. Dashboard > Licences lists the same key, labelled Personal

## Buy a Commercial licence

[![Buy a Commercial licence: poster](https://storage.googleapis.com/buildbase/orgs/6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8-fsyqdskf/assets/file-1795338794604-928021341.webp)](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/commercial-purchase.efad3b34.mp4)

[MP4](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/commercial-purchase.efad3b34.mp4) (1.7 MB) · [WebM](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/commercial-purchase.efad3b34.webm) (2.5 MB) · 1280×720 · 177 s · recorded 2026-11-22

**What it proves:** A buyer can pay for the Studio tier with Stripe (test mode), comes back to the order page with a Commercial licence key, and finds it in Dashboard > Licences.

1. Open the pricing page as a visitor
2. Choose "Sign in to buy"
3. Signed out, so the button opens the hosted BuildBase sign-in page
4. Create a fresh test account (a +test address on the development environment)
5. Enter the verification code (test mode always accepts 424242)
6. Dismiss the optional prompt (passkey or two-factor offer)
7. Dismiss the optional prompt (passkey or two-factor offer)
8. Back on the store, signed in
9. Buy the Studio tier of the Commercial licence
10. Stripe Checkout opens (test mode)
11. Pay with the Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (any future date, any CVC)
12. Paid: Stripe returns to the order page
13. The order page shows the Commercial licence key (masked here)
14. Dashboard > Licences lists the key, labelled Commercial

## Connect Claude Code from /agents

[![Connect Claude Code from /agents: poster](https://storage.googleapis.com/buildbase/orgs/6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8-fsyqdskf/assets/file-1795338794147-419005257.webp)](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/agents-copy-snippet.b84544b9.mp4)

[MP4](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/agents-copy-snippet.b84544b9.mp4) (696 KB) · [WebM](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/agents-copy-snippet.b84544b9.webm) (846 KB) · 1280×720 · 18 s · recorded 2026-11-22

**What it proves:** The /agents page gives a working Claude Code snippet: one click copies the `claude mcp add` command for the studio.

1. Open /agents, the page that explains how an agent connects
2. Choose the Claude Code tab
3. Copy the snippet: the clipboard now holds the `claude mcp add --transport http reelforge …` command (the key stays a placeholder)
4. Scroll on to the per-agent keys and the example prompts

## An agent makes a reel over MCP

[![An agent makes a reel over MCP: poster](https://storage.googleapis.com/buildbase/orgs/6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8-fsyqdskf/assets/file-1795338793210-331334976.webp)](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/agent-session.4cc6d476.mp4)

[MP4](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/agent-session.4cc6d476.mp4) (776 KB) · [WebM](https://reelforge.buildbase.app/walkthroughs/agent-session.4cc6d476.webm) (915 KB) · 1280×720 · 35 s · recorded 2026-11-22

**What it proves:** An agent (Claude Code, claude-sonnet-5-5) drives the studio over MCP from one prompt: list_templates, create_project, validate_project, render_project, get_job until done, get_render_output, and the studio renders a 9 s reel with 4 engines (remotion, motion-canvas, html, hyperframes).

1. Claude Code starts with only the reelforge MCP tools allowed and the prompt
2. list_templates → 4 templates: kinetic-title (remotion), animated-explainer (motion-canvas), html-title (html), hyperframes-title (hyperframes)
3. create_project (manifest "One reel, four engines": 4 scenes, 1080x1920 @ 30 fps (remotion/kineti…) → project tut-claude-code-multi-engine, version 1
4. validate_project (projectId: tut-claude-code-multi-engine) → ok: true, 0 errors, 0 warnings; 4 scenes, 270 frames, 9 s, engines remotion, motion-canvas, html, hyperframes
5. render_project (projectId: tut-claude-code-multi-engine) → job job_mwqtqjjjfb5b2cd251: queued 0% (queued)
6. get_job (jobId: job_mwqtqjjjfb5b2cd251, waitSeconds: 45) → job job_mwqtqjjjfb5b2cd251: running 65% (render:s3: scene 3/4: 55/60 frames)
7. get_job (jobId: job_mwqtqjjjfb5b2cd251, waitSeconds: 45) → job job_mwqtqjjjfb5b2cd251: running 87% (assemble)
8. get_job (jobId: job_mwqtqjjjfb5b2cd251, waitSeconds: 45) → job job_mwqtqjjjfb5b2cd251: succeeded 100% (done), 270 frames, 9 s, 1080x1920
9. get_render_output (jobId: job_mwqtqjjjfb5b2cd251) → [poster image] render run_mwqtqjji30c1e03a60: 9 s, 270 frames, 1080x1920; files 7; download link (signed, masked)
10. The reel plays: 1080x1920, 270 frames, rendered in 107.6 s
